terms.title: Terms & Conditions
terms.desc: Our legal framework for usage and liability.

s1.b: You must be 18 years or older to use CoBuddy. By registering, you confirm you meet this requirement and have the legal capacity to enter into this agreement.

s2.b: CoBuddy connects members for trusted public-only experiences including dining, cultural outings, networking, and wellness activities. The platform is strictly for platonic, professional companionship in verified public settings.

s3.b: You are responsible for all activity under your account. Do not share credentials. CoBuddy reserves the right to suspend accounts for any breach of these terms without prior notice.

s4.b: CoBuddy acts as a connection platform only. We are not liable for conduct between members during or after sessions. Sessions are undertaken at your own discretion.

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.desc: How we protect and manage your data.

s1.b: We collect identity verification data (government ID), contact information, location data during active sessions, and usage analytics to improve your experience.

s2.b: Your data is used exclusively for identity verification, session matching, safety monitoring, and personalized recommendations. We never sell personal data to third parties.

s3.b: All data is encrypted in transit and at rest. We are compliant with applicable regional data protection regulations.

s4.b: You may request access to, correction of, or deletion of your personal data at any time through Settings.

s1.b: All members must treat companions and fellow users with respect. Harassment, discrimination, or any form of disrespectful conduct will result in immediate account suspension.

s2.b: For safety, all first-time meetings must occur in CoBuddy-verified public venues. Never request a companion to meet in private or isolated settings.

s3.b: Any solicitation for services beyond our platform scope (romantic, sexual, or private arrangements) is strictly prohibited and will result in permanent banning and potential legal action.

s4.b: If you experience any behavior that violates these guidelines, use the in-app report feature immediately.
